idea-plugin.name: MCP Migration Lint
idea-plugin.description:
The 2026-07-28 MCP revision removed the initialize handshake, sessions, ping and 4 more RPCs. 27 rules find them in your mcp.json and server code, with the replacement on each line.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MCP Migration Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 27 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/mcp-2026-migration-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/mcp-2026-migration-lint

action.text: MCP Migration Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run MCP Migration Lint on the file in the editor
